spans.s: SV0107 इच्छा icchā Refers to desired attributes- requisition of whatever is not available with us is desire. Is a spiritual attribute. Desire is produced from pleasure. Derived from the enjoyment of garlands, women etc.
AF0892 इच्छाद्वेषौ अनिमित्ततः icchādveṣau animittataḥ Like and Dislike without any reason
